svg.title: Where AVD writes its logs
svg.desc: From left to right: the user and client connect to the Azure Virtual Desktop service, which connects them to a session host. The service writes connection, checkpoint, error, registration and network tables to a Log Analytics workspace once diagnostic settings are on. The session host agent reports its health to the service, which writes it to the service, and the host keeps its own Windows event logs and FSLogix logs. AVD Insights reads the workspace. Connections that never reach the service leave no rows.
